title: fat_proc_axialize_anat
description: Helps align the major axes of an anatomical volume to those of the volumetric field of view.

ref_file.description: Reference volume full name, such as TT or MNI
ref_file.title: Reference file

prefix.description: Output prefix for files and snapshots
prefix.title: Output prefix

workdir.description: Name of the working subdirectory in the output directory
workdir.title: Working directory

out_match_ref.description: Match the final output volume space FOV and spatial resolution to the reference file
out_match_ref.title: Output match reference space flag

do_ceil_out.description: Apply a ceiling based on the 98%ile value within an automasked volume
do_ceil_out.title: Ceiling output flag

extra_al_wtmask.description: Extra weight mask to emphasize specific parts for alignment
extra_al_wtmask.title: Extra weight mask file

extra_al_cost.description: Specify a cost function for 3dAllineate to use (default 'lpa')
extra_al_cost.title: Extra alignment cost function

extra_al_opts.description: Extra options for 3dAllineate when applying the warp
extra_al_opts.title: Extra alignment options

focus_mask.description: Input mask to focus processing and alignment
focus_mask.title: Focus mask file

focus_by_ss.description: Make a mask by simply skullstripping input data set
focus_by_ss.title: Focus by skullstrip flag

remove_inf_sli.description: Remove a number of slices from the inferior part of the FOV
remove_inf_sli.title: Remove inferior slices

pre_align_center_mass.description: Pre-align the centers of mass of the volumes
pre_align_center_mass.title: Pre-align center of mass flag

pre_center_mass.description: Pre-recenter input center of mass to (0, 0, 0)
pre_center_mass.title: Pre-center mass flag

qc_ulay_range.description: Provide a min (UMIN) and max (UMAX) range for underlay grayscale bar
qc_ulay_range.title: QC underlay range

no_qc_view.description: Turn off default QC image saving/viewing
no_qc_view.title: No QC view flag

qc_prefix.description: Provide a prefix for QC outputs separate from the main prefix
qc_prefix.title: QC prefix
